title: Jottacloud: Safe Cloud Storage
summary: Safely store, and easily access all your files and photos anywhere
description:
Securely store your files and access them from any device. Jottacloud is operating under Norwegian privacy laws, one of the world's strictest. Try it for free with 5GB, choose an individual plan with unlimited storage or a Home plan for the family with up to 20TB of storage.

Features:

Cloud storage and backup
- Automatic backup
- Access your files from any device
- Free up space on your device with one click

Photos and videos
- Backup of photos and videos in original quality and size
- Organize your files and photos
- Share photo albums with friends and add comments
- Stream videos to Apple TV or Cast devices

File management
- Share files with anyone via link
- Work on documents directly in Jottacloud
- Easy file search by name
- File details
- Document scanner

Support
- Chat with customer support directly in the app
recentChanges:
- Smoother, more precise scrubbing in the timeline, with haptic feedback as you pass each year
- Clearer pull-to-refresh indicator
- Fixed the PIN code and fingerprint settings disappearing on Android 17
- Fixed blank thumbnails for iPhone (Dolby Vision) videos in the timeline — they could not be opened either
- Bug fixes and stability improvements
